name: @oneshop-inc/sms
description: capacitor sms plugin, similar to @byteowls/capacitor-sms but uses techniques from cordova-sms/cordova-sms-plugin to handle multiple attachments

scripts.verify: npm run verify:ios && npm run verify:android && npm run verify:web
scripts.verify:ios: cd ios && pod install && xcodebuild -workspace Plugin.xcworkspace -scheme Plugin && cd ..
scripts.verify:android: cd android && ./gradlew clean build test && cd ..
scripts.lint: npm run prettier -- --check && npm run swiftlint -- lint
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc && rollup -c rollup.config.mjs
